name: Cable Torso Rotation
steps: Stand sideways to a chest-height pulley with your feet apart and both hands extended toward its handle.
Turn your trunk away from the pulley, carrying the handle across your body at chest level.
Turn back toward the pulley under control.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Let your trailing heel pivot so your knees turn with your hips.
Keep your arms straight at chest height so your obliques drive the turn.
